authEntry.gate.summary.en: We only process the information a feature needs, when you use it. Roam location is used for live position, check-ins and trails, and never collected in the background when you are not using the app.
authEntry.gate.summary.zh-Hans: 城瘾只在你使用相关功能时处理必要信息。漫游定位仅用于实时位置展示、到点打卡和轨迹记录；不使用时不会在后台持续采集。
